summary: Ends the current user session on the cloud backend and clears it from the browser.
description: Log Out ends the current session when its `login` input (displayed 'Do', signal) is triggered: the backend session is revoked, the stored session is removed from the browser, and the app-wide user service switches to logged-out — updating every User node (`authenticated` becomes false) and firing their Logged Out signal. `success` (signal) fires when this completes; `failure` (signal) fires with `error` (string value) set if the request fails.
whenToUse: The action behind a log-out button or menu item. To react to the session ending (e.g. navigate to the login page), listen on this node's `success` or the User node's Logged Out signal.

ports.login: Signal input (displayed 'Do'); note the file-key name is `login` even though this node logs out.
ports.success: Signal; fires once the session has ended.
ports.failure: Signal; fires if the logout request fails. Read `error` for the message.

patterns: Button `onClick` → `login` (Do), `success` → navigate to the public/login page.
